svg.title: Stencil cut-outs
svg.text: Cut out a card, tape it on thin clear plastic, and an adult cuts the black shapes through both. Lesson 08.3.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
small circles: use a hole punch
Adults only: cut on a cutting mat with small scissors or a craft knife. Smooth sharp corners. Wash before first use.
Use: hold flat, dab with a nearly dry sponge from the edges in, lift straight up. Never over the eyes.
After use: soapy water, rinse, press dry between paper towels. Keep it for face paint only.
